AHC's approach is componentized (e.g., bathrooms/kitchens + panels) and built for factory repeatability; each module is designed to fit standard shipping containers for cost-efficient logistics and national deployment. AHC is raising $50M to build out their first "Gigafactory" that will enable AHC to drive costs lower, expand margins, and scale production from dozens of units a year to over a thousand. The Series A round is fully subscribed and led by Contrary Ventures. Our participation in their Seed round and leading their last Bridge round gives our LPs exclusive access to allocation. WHY NOW Manufacturing inflection AHC has moved from concept to validated system quickly, and the binding constraint is now production capacity-not demand.
